faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application is 10th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.A. in Hindu Studies/Allied Subject/Philosophy/Sanskrit/Ancient Indian History with at least 55% marks, along with UGC NET/JRF or a Ph.D. in the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the Panjab University Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) role?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview date for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled to be held on 19th August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Panjab University, which is http://jobs.puchd.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit specified for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.
